brief: The 7 failure modes of AI agents in production — and the playbook to detect each one.

slots.body: Seven critical failure modes hiding in production agents—and the exact detection playbook to catch each one before users notice.
Agents fabricate facts when retrieval fails or confidence thresholds are missing. Detect drift by grounding every output to verified sources.
slots.card1Body: RAG pipelines, support bots, and research agents that cite external knowledge.
slots.card2Body: Add a citation validator step; hallucinations drop 80% when outputs must reference a source ID.

slots.body: Agents select the wrong tool or hallucinate parameters, causing cascading API errors. Instrument every call with strict schema validation.
slots.card1Body: Function-calling agents, coding copilots, and workflows with external API integrations.
slots.card2Body: Log tool-selection distributions; a sudden entropy spike signals parameter drift before it explodes.

slots.body: Agents get stuck in repetitive cycles when termination logic is vague or rewards are misaligned. Cap iterations and detect state churn.
slots.card1Body: Autonomous planners, multi-step workflows, and recursive reasoning chains.
slots.card2Body: Hash the agent state each step; identical hashes across three ticks means a loop.

slots.body: Long sessions overflow the context window or bury key instructions, causing amnesia. Compress history and surface system prompts early.
slots.card1Body: Long-running chatbots, multi-turn negotiations, and agents with large tool kits.
slots.card2Body: Track token utilization per turn; steep ramps predict instruction loss before it happens.

slots.body: Agents bypass safety filters or leak sensitive data when policy layers sit too far from execution. Inline guardrails catch violations early.
slots.card1Body: Customer-facing agents, healthcare copilots, and any system handling PII or secrets.
slots.card2Body: Run output classifiers on intermediate steps, not just final responses, to catch jailbreaks.

slots.body: Agents return malformed JSON or trigger timeout cascades under load. Enforce response contracts with parsers and circuit breakers.
slots.card1Body: High-traffic APIs, structured-output agents, and cost-sensitive production workloads.
slots.card2Body: P95 latency jumps precede schema errors; treat slowdowns as early warnings of format drift.

slots.body: Pick one failure mode to instrument this week. Detection beats disaster every single time.
slots.quote: Observability is the only insurance in production.
